about.title: About Teinc Food
about.p1: Teinc Food is a food delivery platform that connects buyers, restaurants, and riders in cities around the world.
about.p2: We believe great food should be easy to find, easy to order, and easy to deliver — for everyone involved.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Quick answers to the questions we hear most.
faq.a1: Teinc Food is rolling out across cities now. Check the app for availability in your area.
faq.q2: How do I become a rider?
faq.a2: Download the Teinc Food Business app, sign up as a rider, and complete the simple onboarding steps.
faq.a3: You can pay by card, mobile money, or cash on delivery — your choice at checkout.
faq.q4: How do I partner my restaurant?
faq.a4: Reach out through the contact page and our team will help you get set up quickly.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, contact details, delivery address, and order history.
privacy.p2: We use your information to provide, improve, and secure our services — including fulfilling orders and delivering support.
privacy.p3: We only share data with partners (restaurants, riders, payment providers) as needed to complete your orders.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: By using Teinc Food you agree to order food, provide delivery, or operate a business in compliance with applicable law.
terms.p2: Payments are processed securely. Refunds follow the policy displayed in the app at the time of your order.
terms.p3: Teinc Food connects buyers, restaurants, and riders. Each party is responsible for their own obligations.
